title: Android System Update (April 2016)
description:
This software update will upgrade your device to the April 2016 release of Android 6.0.1 Marshmallow, which improves security and stability and fixes bugs. Downloading updates over a mobile network or while roaming may cause additional charges.

Update perangkat lunak ini akan meningkatkan keamanan perangkat Android One Anda. Perlu diperhatikan bahwa mengunduh update melalui jaringan seluler atau saat roaming dapat dikenakan biaya tambahan.
